title: 第九章 得丹炉互通有无第十章 万事具备前往盘丝洞
slug: 西游从蜈蚣精到百目真君
content_zh:
“妙。”
吴耀翻到一处关于药性相济的论述，抬头道。
“凌道友你看，你丹鉴上说‘寒者热之，热者寒之’，五毒丹经上也有一句‘毒者药之，药者毒之’。
说法不同，道理是一样的。
万物皆有其性，用对了就是药，用错了就是毒。”
凌虚子凑过来一看，拍案叫绝：
“正是正是！
贫道以前总觉得五毒入药太过凶险，今日一见才明白。
不是五毒凶险，是贫道的炼丹之法还不够圆融！”
两人越聊越投机，从药材炮制聊到火候掌控，从丹方配伍聊到药理本源。
吴耀理论扎实，凌虚子经验丰富，两人互相补充，不知不觉便聊了两个多时辰。
期间熊罴打了两个盹，醒来看他俩还在滔滔不绝地聊，翻了个白眼继续睡。
聊到兴头上，吴耀忽然话锋一转：“凌道友，我有个不情之请。
我想借道友的丹炉，试着炼一炉丹。”
凌虚子闻言，先是一愣，随即摆了摆手：“借什么借，道友不必如此客气。不过……”
他略一沉吟，站起身来走到洞厅角落，从一堆杂物中拖出一只蒙了灰的青铜丹炉。
这只丹炉比正中央那只略小一号，样式却如出一辙，同样的三足双耳，同样的螭虎钮。
只是炉身上多了几道细微的裂纹，看着有些年头了。
“正中央那只丹炉是贫道日常所用，跟贫道多年，用顺手了不好送人。”
凌虚子拍了拍那只蒙灰的丹炉，拂去灰尘，露出下面古朴的铜色。

“这只是贫道早年得的，品相虽不如那只，但在凡俗之中也算顶级的货色。
道友若不嫌弃，这个就送给道友了。”
吴耀仔细打量那只丹炉，炉身虽有几道细纹，但整体完好，炉壁厚实，火道通畅，确实是上好的凡俗丹炉。
在修行界中，法宝级别的丹炉可遇不可求。
绝大多数炼丹之士用的都是凡俗丹炉，而眼前这只在凡俗丹炉中已经算得上顶尖了。
“这怎么好意思。”吴耀连忙推辞，“我只是借来一用，道友何必如此破费。”
凌虚子却不由分说地将丹炉搬到了吴耀面前，正色道：“道友不必推辞。
这本五毒丹经让贫道开了眼界，区区一只丹炉算什么？
再说这也不是什么法宝，就是凡俗之物，不值几个钱。
道友如今正缺丹炉，再去四处寻找又要耽误不知多少时日，收下便是。
你我是同道中人，这些虚礼就不必讲了。”
吴耀见他神色诚恳，知道再推辞反倒显得生分，便不再多言，双手接过丹炉，郑重地道了声谢。
他将这份人情记在了心里。
这丹炉确实不是什么法宝，但这份雪中送炭的情谊，比法宝更贵重。
凌虚子见吴耀收了丹炉，眉开眼笑，又兴致勃勃地拉着吴耀回到石桌前：
“来来来，咱们继续方才的话题。道友刚才说到五毒归元丹的君臣配伍，贫道觉得与我丹鉴中的归元丹有些相似之处……”
从这天起，吴耀便暂时在凌虚子的地盘住了下来。
凌虚子的洞府旁边还有一处闲置的小山洞，虽然简陋，但胜在清静，收拾一番便能住人。
熊罴见两人凑在一起天天研究炼丹，也不多打扰，回了黑风洞。
content_en:
"Wonderful."
Wu Yao turned to a discussion about the synergy of medicinal properties, raised his head and said.
"Look, fellow Daoist Ling, your elixir book says, 'What is cold is what is hot, and what is hot is what is cold.' There is also a saying in the Five Poisons Alchemy Sutra: 'Poison is the medicine, and medicine is the poison.'
The explanations are different, but the truth is the same.
Everything has its own nature. If used correctly, it is medicine; if used incorrectly, it is poison. "
Ling Xuzi came over to take a look and was amazed:
"Exactly!
Pindao always felt that the five poisons were too dangerous when used as medicine, but he understood it when he saw it today.
It's not that the five poisons are dangerous, it's that the method of refining alchemy is not perfect enough! "
The more the two chatted, the more speculative they became, from the preparation of medicinal materials to the control of heat, from the compatibility of elixirs to the origin of pharmacology.
Wu Yao had solid theories and Ling Xuzi had rich experience. The two complemented each other and chatted for more than two hours without realizing it.
During this period, Xiong Yan took a nap for two times. When he woke up, he saw that the two of them were still chatting. He rolled his eyes and went back to sleep.
When the conversation got underway, Wu Yao suddenly changed the subject: "Fellow Daoist Ling, I have a gracious favor.
I want to borrow a Taoist friend's alchemy furnace and try to make a furnace of elixirs. "
When Ling Xuzi heard this, he was stunned for a moment, then waved his hand: "What can I borrow, fellow Taoist, you don't have to be so polite. But..."
He pondered for a moment, stood up, walked to the corner of the cave hall, and pulled out a dusty bronze alchemy furnace from a pile of debris.
This alchemy furnace is slightly smaller than the one in the center, but the style is exactly the same, with the same three legs and ears, and the same tiger button.
There are just a few small cracks on the furnace body, which looks like it has been there for a while.
"The alchemy furnace in the center is used daily by Pindao. He has been with Pindao for many years. It's hard to give it away once it's used well."
Ling Xuzi patted the dusty alchemy furnace and brushed away the dust, revealing the simple copper color underneath.
"This was only acquired by Pindao in his early years. Although the quality is not as good as that one, it is still considered top-notch among ordinary people.
If fellow Taoist don't dislike it, I'll give this to fellow Taoist. "
Wu Yao looked at the alchemy furnace carefully. Although there were a few fine lines on the furnace body, the whole furnace was in good condition. The furnace wall was thick and the fire channel was smooth. It was indeed a top-notch ordinary alchemy furnace.
In the world of spiritual practice, magic weapon-level pill furnaces are hard to come by.
The vast majority of alchemists use ordinary alchemy furnaces, and the one in front of me is already considered top-notch among the ordinary alchemy furnaces.
"How embarrassing." Wu Yao quickly declined, "I just borrowed it for a use, why do fellow Taoists spend so much money."
Ling Xuzi moved the alchemy furnace in front of Wu Yao without any explanation, and said seriously: "Fellow Taoist, there is no need to refuse.
This Book of Five Poison Pills opened Pindao's eyes. What is a mere pill furnace?
Besides, this is not a magic weapon, it is just a common thing, not worth much money.
Fellow Taoist is currently short of the alchemy furnace, and it will take an unknown amount of time to search everywhere, so just accept it.
You and I are of the same mind, so there is no need to talk about these false etiquette. "
Seeing his sincere expression, Wu Yao knew that any further refusal would make him look aggravated, so he stopped talking, took the alchemy furnace with both hands, and solemnly thanked him.
He kept this favor in his heart.
This alchemy furnace is indeed not a magic weapon, but this friendship that provides help in times of need is more valuable than a magic weapon.
Ling Xuzi smiled happily when he saw Wu Yao had collected the alchemy furnace, and then happily pulled Wu Yao back to the stone table:
"Come on, let's continue the topic we just talked about. My Taoist friend just talked about the compatibility of the Five Poisons Guiyuan Pills with kings and ministers. I feel that there are some similarities with the Guiyuan Pills in my elixir book..."
From that day on, Wu Yao temporarily lived in Ling Xuzi's territory.
There is an unused small cave next to Ling Xuzi's cave. Although it is simple and crude, it is quieter and can be occupied by people after tidying it up.
Xiong Zhi saw the two of them studying alchemy together every day, so he didn't bother them much and returned to Batu Caves.
